invalidation.protocol: Restore initial fixture files and prime the incremental cache before each mutation. For the four ordinary input mutations, compare two failing incremental invocations with an uncached invocation, then restore files and require successful recovery. For three missing/unusable cache mutations, require invalid source to fail and restored source to recover with current-version state. These are correctness probes, not timed performance conditions.

validation.scope: Isolated committed engine, roles and helpers plus these two test edits and proposal; unrelated bounded-path-scan and role work excluded.
validation.logs: The author keeps full probe, comparison and validation logs outside the repository.

limitations: Five deliberately removed integration scenarios change the workload; this is not an identical-work engine optimization.
The 1.35% combined reduction is an observed three-sample local median, with no confidence interval or statistical significance claim.
Per-file durations come from the same concurrent invocations and are not independent isolated-file measurements.
Retained real timeouts dominate the launcher file, limiting combined elapsed savings despite lower continuation work.
Mutation evidence covers only the selected rule and wiring faults; it does not prove preservation against all defects.
No whole-suite before/after timing comparison, CI-wide saving or cross-platform performance result is established.
